endorsements.name: Jonathan Grier
endorsements.label: Catching Insider Data Theft with Stochastic Forensics
endorsements.description: A stochastic process is, by definition, something unpredictable, but unpredictable in a precise way. Think of the molecules in a gas: we can't predict how any individual molecule will move and shake; but by accepting that randomness and describing it mathematically, we can use the laws of statistics to accurately predict the gas's overall behavior.
